title: Gentle De-Shedding & Undercoat Brushing Masterclass
description: Learn the proper line-brushing technique to remove dead undercoat without pulling skin or causing brush burn.
steps: Choose a slicker brush and metal greyhound comb.
Work in small sections starting from the neck toward the tail.
Always brush in the natural direction of hair growth with gentle wrist strokes.
Reward your pet with a treat after every completed body quadrant.

title: Stress-Free Bathing & Coat Conditioning Routine
description: Transform bath time into a calm spa ritual. Covers water temperature, tearless face cleaning, and deep lathering.
steps: Place a non-slip rubber mat in the tub bottom to eliminate slipping anxiety.
Dilute shampoo in a squeeze bottle for effortless distribution without residue.
Protect ears with cotton balls and rinse thoroughly from head downward.

title: Safe Nail Trimming & Quick-Identification Guide
description: Step-by-step guidance on identifying the nail quick, using guillotine or scissor clippers, and calming nervous paws.
steps: Keep styptic powder or cornstarch within reach before starting.
Hold the paw firmly but gently, separating individual toes.
Clip small 2mm slivers at a 45-degree angle rather than one large cut.
Stop immediately once you see a central white or dark chalky circle.

title: Feline & Canine Gentle Ear Cleaning & Hygiene
description: Prevent yeast and bacterial ear infections using veterinarian-approved drying solutions and cotton pads.
steps: Fill the ear canal with vet-recommended cleanser until liquid is visible.
Massage the base of the ear for 30 seconds to loosen wax debris.
Allow your pet to shake their head freely.
Wipe away dislodged debris with a soft gauze pad; never insert cotton swabs.
